findings.text: Unset removes entries from ExpectedCalls while ranging over the original slice with a stale index. After a removal the elements shift left, so the next element is skipped. With two adjacent expectations matching the same method and arguments, the second one is not removed. The loop also keeps reading the stale tail, so the last element is seen twice and the wrong index may be removed.

raw:
Removing elements while ranging by index: after removal, the range continues over the original slice header (length fixed), so the shifted elements get skipped. Consecutive matching calls are missed, and the range reads stale or duplicated tail elements. Upstream testify has the same pattern, but it is still a defect here.
